subject.title: fix(msteams): bound SSO API JSON response reads to prevent OOM

question: Should maintainers accept the SDK sign-in route replacement based on route-level proof, or require live Teams tenant proof before merge?
rationale: The patch is a narrow hardening fix with green CI and strong route-level proof, but it intentionally replaces an SDK-owned auth path and no live tenant credentials are available in the contributor environment.

options.title: Accept route-level proof
options.body: Proceed with maintainer review and merge if owners are comfortable that the tests preserve SDK route behavior for normal, oversized, and USGov token-host cases.

options.title: Require live tenant proof
options.body: Ask for maintainer-run or credentialed proof against a real Teams/Bot Framework OAuth connection before landing the auth-route replacement.

options.title: Defer route replacement
options.body: Keep helper-level bounded-read work separate and pause replacing the live SDK routes until a broader SDK-parity plan is available.

recommendation.title: Accept route-level proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with maintainer review and merge if owners are comfortable that the tests preserve SDK route behavior for normal, oversized, and USGov token-host cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the SDK migration that owns the route behavior being replaced and is the best available owner for accepting the compatibility risk.
